entities.name: Genuin Monetize
entities.description: Revenue platform that empowers brands, publishers, and media networks to unlock new revenue streams by transforming audience engagement with video across onsite and offsite channels.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: A network of trusted partner inventory through which brands can extend reach and distribute sponsored content offsite.

entities.name: Sponsored Content
entities.description: Monetization solution enabling direct integration of branded posts and takeovers as premium native video experiences.

entities.name: Programmatic Advertising
entities.description: Monetization solution leveraging both open and direct programmatic demand for scalable in-feed and in-stream video ad placements.

entities.name: IAB-Compatible Audience Extension
entities.description: Monetization solution utilizing industry-standard IAB-compatible ad units to drive quality audience extension and replace low-value content widgets.

entities.name: Onsite Sponsored Content
entities.description: Use case converting direct sponsor demand into premium native video experiences on a brand's owned and operated properties, such as sponsored posts on product detail pages.

entities.name: Onsite Programmatic
entities.description: Use case optimizing yield with automated programmatic in-feed and in-stream video ads to fill and scale revenue on owned sites.

entities.name: Onsite IAB Extension
entities.description: Use case driving quality audience extension with IAB-compatible banner units on owned properties, replacing low-value content widgets.

entities.name: Offsite Sponsored Content
entities.description: Use case scaling direct sponsor campaigns by placing branded video content on trusted partner inventory within the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Offsite IAB Extension
entities.description: Use case expanding reach and monetizing audience extension programmatically using portable IAB-compatible video ad units across partner sites.

entities.name: Publishers
entities.description: Content publishers who use the platform to maximize ad revenue through automated high-quality video ad placements on their properties.

entities.name: Retail Media Networks
entities.description: Retail-operated media networks that monetize their digital properties by integrating sponsored content and programmatic ads within product experiences.

entities.name: Community Media Networks
entities.description: Community-driven media networks that leverage the platform to unlock new revenue streams through video-based monetization.

entities.name: Advertisers
entities.description: Brands and advertisers who run sponsored and programmatic campaigns through the platform, benefiting from high engagement and native video experiences.

entities.name: CPG Brands
entities.description: Consumer packaged goods brands cited as example advertisers distributing sponsored video campaigns across a network of relevant partner sites.

relationships.description: Genuin Monetize offers Sponsored Content as a core monetization solution.
Genuin Monetize offers Programmatic Advertising as a core monetization solution.
Genuin Monetize offers IAB-Compatible Audience Extension as a core monetization solution.
Onsite Sponsored Content is an onsite application of the Sponsored Content solution.
Onsite Programmatic is an onsite application of the Programmatic Advertising solution.
Onsite IAB Extension is an onsite application of the IAB-Compatible Audience Extension solution.
Offsite Sponsored Content is an offsite application of the Sponsored Content solution.
Offsite IAB Extension is an offsite application of the IAB-Compatible Audience Extension solution.
Offsite Sponsored Content distributes branded content through trusted partner inventory in the Genuin Network.
Offsite IAB Extension runs portable IAB ad units across partner sites in the Genuin Network.
Genuin Monetize extends monetization offsite by tapping into the Genuin Network's partner inventory.
Genuin Monetize is designed for publishers seeking to maximize ad revenue on their properties.
Genuin Monetize is designed for retail media networks monetizing their digital presence.
Genuin Monetize is designed for community media networks seeking new revenue streams.
Genuin Monetize serves advertisers by delivering high-engagement native video ad experiences.
Example scenario: a large retailer running a brand's sponsored post within product detail pages.
Example scenario: a CPG brand distributing its sponsored video campaign across a network of relevant brands.
